name: Utagoe
source:
Main character is a president of an idol studio. Now he needs to choose one of the girls to debut as an idol. Soon the whole world will know about her!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一家偶像事务所的社长，如今必须从相原里美、篠崎花奈与鸣海玲之中选出一人出道成为偶像。很快，全世界都会知道她的名字！

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
